t: The Essentials 13A single gang switched metal clad socket provides a reliable power point for demanding trade environments. Its rugged design and tough, durable metal-clad finish ensure longevity, making it ideal for workshops, garages, and industrial applications. The socket features a powder-coated finish for enhanced protection and is supplied with a mounting box and fixings for straightforward installation. With 20mm side and base knockouts, offering 6 x entry points, cable management is flexible. White inserts and switch operation complement the grey finish, and screw terminals accept 3 x 2.5mm² cables for secure connections.
b: Ideal for Workshops, Garages & Industrial Use
